# A11-S06: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

This was also just to give you an idea of the whole lot :-) I have made a
select list of the best articles below.

It would surely make sense to quote Metro or The Times of India, as those
are the biggest Anglophone sites to bring the story.

However, I think the article in Le Figaro is the best piece of journalism,
as they have conducted an original interview with me and have had an AI
professor give an expert opinion. So, I would maybe quote this in the
front, and then the two in English for accessibility.

Quote: "The global debate on "Life with Artificials" as 18th SDG is
currently burning up in social media and the international news. The
discussion is being facilitated through The Synthetic Party and Computer
Lars, and new articles are constantly appearing in Arabic, French, English,
Japanese, Chinese, Lithuanian, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish,
German, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, etc. In the middle of this Babel Tower are
some of the largest media houses such as DMG, Le Figaro, La Stampa and The
Times of India."

Maybe you can also use something from the press release I made on the
international attention:
